name: Lysevatten - Hasteröd
description: Lysevatten to Hasteröd. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Before final import, live-check WST Djupevatten notice to confirm whether the unauthorized adjacent structure has been removed.
Use WST linked GPX/API, not OSM relation 125070, unless the Hasterod boundary mismatch is explicitly resolved.
Run final protected-area and water-protection line-buffer overlay; current rules lane found no direct protected-area/Natura intersection but used a screening pass.
De-duplicate repeated coordinates before length, snapping, simplification or route matching.
WST alternate GPX bohusleden_etapp10.gpx exists with 2352 points and same endpoints but is unlinked/variant; do not prefer it over linked official etapp10.gpx.
OSM relation 125070 extends about 723 m beyond official Hasterod endpoint and should not override official WST geometry.

facilities.name: Djupevatten shelter cluster
facilities.description: Official shelter cluster by Djupevatten, suitable for break, overnight stay and swimming; includes shelter, grill/fireplace, seating and regular waste bin. Model as one cluster rather than duplicate shelter/firepit/waste POIs unless child amenities are supported. WST place text says shelter and grill place were built in November 2024.
